How much RF energy does Temple emit? Is it really safe to use 24x7?

Absolutely yes. Because we keep data transmission off most of the time, and even when it is on, it operates at such low radio power that it is even exempt from FCC SAR testing requirements.

10-minute estimate under standard usage conditions.

FCC: Federal Communications Commission
SAR: Specific Absorption Rate
